title: Implement smart skill matching
description: Modify orchestrator.service.ts matchSkill() to use keyword matching first (Tier 1), then LLM fallback with Tier 2 for ambiguous matches. Inject only Tier 2 by default, Tier 3 on demand.
acceptance_criteria: Keyword matching resolves obvious matches without LLM call
Ambiguous matches use LLM with Tier 2 content
Specialist prompts receive Tier 2 by default
Tier 3 injected only when task needs code examples
